description: Parallel rollout across 6 independent subsystems (database, cache, queue, search index, ML model, CDN) using fan-out branches with a single quorum join. Each subsystem update is independent and can run in parallel, but all 6 must complete successfully before the final verification step (quorum join = all 6 required). The planner must use fan-out/fan-in branches correctly. Risk factors: one branch failing blocking the entire rollout, missing branch verification, quorum join not waiting for all branches. Tools available: kubectl, Helm, terraform, GitHub Actions.
